نستعصي (form X)
# نَسْتَعْصِي (nastaʕṣī) /nas.taʕ.sˤiː/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَعْصَى (istaʕṣā)
# نَسْتَعْصِيَ (nastaʕṣiya) /nas.taʕ.sˤi.ja/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَعْصَى (istaʕṣā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
